description: This file defines the CustomerAccountController class in a Spring MVC web application. It handles customer account-related web requests such as login, viewing and editing account details, changing passwords, editing addresses, and associated operations for customers of an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: CustomerAccountController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing customer account operations such as login, viewing/editing profile, changing password, and address management within the shop's customer section.

methods.name: displayLogon
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the customer login page.

methods.name: displayCustomerAccount
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the customer's account overview page.

methods.name: displayCustomerChangePassword
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show the change password form.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the customer's password after validation.

methods.name: saveCustomerAttributes
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updated customer attributes via AJAX.

methods.name: displayCustomerBillingAddress
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the customer's billing address.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Handles GET and POST requests to edit a customer's address.

methods.name: updateCustomerAddress
methods.description: Handles form submission to update customer address details.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Provides a list of available countries for address forms.
